sections.title: Letter sound
paragraphs: The letter name is (efe) /ˈɛfi/. It makes the sound in (fogo) /ˈfo.ɣu/, which means fire. This letter makes only one sound.

sections.title: Mouth shape
paragraphs: Bring your bottom lip against your top front teeth. Blow air through the narrow gap. Keep your voice off so your throat does not vibrate. Put a hand on your throat to feel that it stays still.

sections.title: Reading rules
paragraphs: The letter (efe) /ˈɛfi/ always makes the same sound in all positions. You hear it at the start of (fogo) /ˈfo.ɣu/. You also hear it in the middle of (café) /kɐˈfɛ/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: This sound is identical to the English sound in fire. There is no real pitfall with this letter.
